_comment: Per-logo settings for build_collected_display.py, keyed by collected asset id. facing: the share of a faint shape's edge that must meet the page for it to be redrawn (default 0.5; higher keeps more of a logo's own colours). light / dark: false keeps the file's own colours on that ground; "plate" shows them on a light plate of their own there. skip: true leaves the file out.

historical-capital-health-region-2000-da.note: The C of Capital is drawn over the weave's pale strands, so reversing either loses it.
As the dark-grey version: the C is drawn over the weave's pale strands.

source-forest-enhancement-society-fesbc-.note: One colour value paints both BC in the badge and the anniversary ring, so the ring cannot be darkened without BC; kept as drawn.
